scripts.build: ENV_FILE=.local/docker/env/docker.env; [ -f "$ENV_FILE" ] || ENV_FILE=.env.docker; EG_BACKEND_ENV_FILE="$ENV_FILE" docker compose --project-directory . --env-file "$ENV_FILE" -f infra/docker/compose/docker-compose.yml build
scripts.build:frontend-host: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm --filter frontend-host run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter webmodeler-backend run typecheck && pnpm --filter webmodeler-frontend run typecheck
scripts.test:unit: pnpm --filter webmodeler-backend run test:unit && pnpm --filter webmodeler-frontend run test:unit

scripts.test:engine-import: pnpm --dir backend exec vitest run __tests__/shared/schemas/platform-admin/configBundle.test.ts __tests__/shared/services/platform-admin/configBundleApplyService.test.ts __tests__/shared/services/platform-admin/configBundleExportService.test.ts --config vitest.config.ts --reporter=dot
scripts.test:identity-mapping-matrix: pnpm --dir backend exec vitest run __tests__/shared/services/platform-admin/identityProviderAdapter.test.ts __tests__/shared/services/platform-admin/genericSamlService.test.ts __tests__/shared/services/platform-admin/directLdapIdentityService.test.ts __tests__/shared/services/platform-admin/identityEntitlementMappingService.test.ts __tests__/shared/services/platform-admin/ssoNormalizedIdentityService.test.ts --config vitest.config.ts --reporter=dot
scripts.test:identity-protocol-mocks: pnpm --dir backend exec vitest run __tests__/shared/services/platform-admin/identityProviderMockContracts.test.ts __tests__/shared/services/platform-admin/genericSamlService.test.ts __tests__/shared/services/platform-admin/directLdapIdentityService.test.ts --config vitest.config.ts --reporter=dot
scripts.test:authz-refactor: pnpm run test:identity-contract && pnpm run test:identity-integration && pnpm run test:legacy-auth-integration && pnpm run test:config-bundles && pnpm run test:secret-boundaries && pnpm run test:target-ownership && pnpm run test:engine-import && pnpm run test:identity-mapping-matrix && pnpm run test:identity-protocol-mocks

scripts.test:ci: pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:integration && pnpm run test:e2e && pnpm --filter webmodeler-backend run db:cleanup-test-data
scripts.test:ci:pr: pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:integration && pnpm run test:e2e:smoke && pnpm --filter webmodeler-backend run db:cleanup-test-data
scripts.plugin-api:pack: mkdir -p ./.artifacts && cd packages/enterprise-plugin-api && pnpm pack && mv *.tgz ../../.artifacts/
